Jumped Ok faced breeze half off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, half off 200m, 1 length off passing 100m, kept on well late # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping made contact with another runner

Jumped Well to lead half clear, ridden along turn, headed Straightening Up and dropped out # disappointing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze half off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up joint lead, headed approaching 100m, kept on ok but no match once headed # breeze/kept on

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat handy 1 length off, improved turn, Straightened Up half off, took over passing 200m, joined 100m, 2 horse battle to the line, lost in photo # had chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well landed box seat 2 Lengths off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off held up, clear 200m 1 length off, half off 100m, took over 50m, kept on strong, just did enough # had run/fell in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; settled on pace. Shortly after the start shifted out and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Restrained to race @ rear 3 Wide With Cover (6L from lead) early . Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed out Four Wide @ 400m. Pushed along Six Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 200m & ran on OK in last 150m. # Last 200m OK.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped and was then shifted behind runners in the early stages. Raced ungenerously in the early stages and refused to settle.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped fine from the Inside . Went Forward on rail 2nd, within 1 length @ 550m. off fence Straightening Up all Clear . Joined briefly 200m then No Match for winner # solid on-speed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped another rnr. Near the 200m  shifted out and made contact with another rnr
